title: 応用生化学
subtitle: Applied Biochemistry
educationalGoal: Biochemistry that elucidates phenomena occurring in life at the molecular level has evolved as a life science including development of applied technology in the medical field. You learn the characteristic structures of amino acids, proteins, nucleic acids, sugars, and lipids as fundamental knowledge of life sciences, and then the chemical and physiochemical features and the biological functions of those biomolecules.
advice: 1. Enzyme (structural features and fuctions) 2. Enzyme kinetics (Michaelis-Menten equation, Lineweaver-Burk plot, Km, Vmax, kcat) and vitamins 3. Catabolism process of glucose (glycolysis, TCA cycle, electron transport system, oxidative phosphorylation) 4. Catabolism process of lipids (beta oxidation of fatty acids) 5. Protein degradation and catabolism process of amino acids
books: Textbooks:Fundamentals of Biological Macromolecules (ed. M. Hasegawa et al.) Reference books: Reserved books:
requiredKnowledge: The textbook used in the lecture of the fundamental of biological macromolecules will be continued to be used in this lecture. It is good to read the textbook and to organize the important matters on the summary notebook.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the structural features and functions of enzymes.
Be able to calculate the reaction rate parameters using enzyme kinetics.
Be able to explain the catabolism process of glucose.
Be able to explain the catabolism process of fatty acids.
Be able to explain the protein degradation and the catabolism process of amino acids.
